title: Kari Diye Kinlam
desc: Sisters Lakshmi and Sati pursue independence but face recurring challenges in their individual journeys.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Handa and Bhonda
desc: The spirit of a man's late wife grants the wishes of her husband and her son for seven days in hopes that they find common ground with one another.

title: Pabitra Papi
desc: To teach Bhola a lesson, Rajib marries his sister, deceives them out of their land, and has Bhola imprisoned. However, Bhola vows to seek justice and avenge the wrongs done to his family.

title: Aakrosh
desc: Two detectives investigate the disappearance of three medical students in a small village, but their search is hampered by corrupt local authorities.

title: Sundar Bou
desc: Sabitri, who is married to Nanda, is exploited daily by her mother-in-law. Seeing this, her uncle decides to help her overcome her problems.

title: Mama Bhagne
desc: Raja, a lazy man, gets married to Payel under the assumption that she is from a wealthy family. However, he is shocked to learn that Payel's father is a gardener.
